fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Both article-mode and latest-mode records share the SAME rich shape (id/slug/headline/articleBody/author/...), sourced primarily from the WordPress REST API (S1-wpapi) -- this site's RSS feed is broken (see CRAWLING_METHOD.md), so latest mode also uses the REST API rather than a thin title/link feed shape. A degraded HTML-only fallback (S2-html, headline + body only) is used only if the REST API call itself fails.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: S1-wpapi (WordPress REST API, primary -- used for both article and latest mode), S2-html (degraded fallback, used only if the REST API call fails).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, http_500, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

id.title: Post ID
id.description: Internal numeric WordPress post ID. S1-wpapi only.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL slug of the post. S1-wpapi only. Can be a bare numeric string (the post's own ID) for a small number of posts with an empty title -- a genuine CMS publish-workflow glitch, not a parse failure -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md.

link.title: Link
link.description: Canonical article URL, as reported by the WordPress REST API.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, HTML-entity-decoded and tag-stripped. Can be null/empty for the rare empty-title posts described above (S1-wpapi).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary from the WordPress excerpt (S1-wpapi). Always null on the S2-html fallback -- this site has no meta description or ld+json to fall back on.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, paragraphs joined with a blank line.

date.title: Date
date.description: Publish date/time, verbatim from WordPress (site-local time, no timezone suffix). S1-wpapi only; always null on S2-html (no reliable date source in raw HTML on this site).

date_gmt.title: Date (UTC)
date_gmt.description: Publish date/time in UTC, verbatim from the WordPress REST API (field name kept as upstream: date_gmt). S1-wpapi only.

modified.title: Modified
modified.description: Last-modified date/time in site-local time, verbatim from WordPress. S1-wpapi only.

modified_gmt.title: Modified (UTC)
modified_gmt.description: Last-modified date/time in UTC, verbatim from WordPress. S1-wpapi only.

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name, from the WP REST API's embedded author object (S1-wpapi). Always null on S2-html -- no reliable author element found in raw HTML on this site.

authorSlug.title: Author slug
authorSlug.description: WordPress author archive slug. S1-wpapi only.

authorLink.title: Author link
authorLink.description: URL of the author's archive page on the site. S1-wpapi only.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of category names attached to the post (e.g. ["Featured"], ["Sport"]). S1-wpapi only.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: List of tag names attached to the post. S1-wpapi only.

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: WordPress-internal GUID URL (e.g. https://www.thisdaylive.com/?p=1240499). S1-wpapi only.

contentProtected.title: Content protected
contentProtected.description: WordPress's own paywall/protected-content flag on the post body -- observed false on every sampled article (no paywall found on this site). S1-wpapi only.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
